logp.method_description: Octanol/water partition coefficients of complexes 1–3 were determined by the shake flask method in PBS buffer, according to reported procedures. (115) The solvents used in the assays and calibration curves were previously saturated in each other, by stirring the mixtures for 48 h. Equal volumes (5 mL) of solutions of the complexes in PBS (pH 7.4) were mixed with n-octanol and placed in 15 mL screw-cap vials. [Complex 1] = 1.4 mM, [complex 2] = 0.47 mM, and [complex 3] = 0.91 mM. The mixtures were vigorously stirred for 22 h and allowed to stand for 2 h, and the phases were separated. After adequate dilution of the samples, their UV absorption spectra were measured, and the concentration was determined from calibration curves obtained for each phase. The following wavelengths were used in the determination: 267, 270, and 287 nm, for 1, 2, and 3, respectively. The distribution coefficients, D, were obtained as the ratio between the concentrations in the organic and aqueous phases.
